page_title: PIXRAY - We drive sustainable copyright enforcement business models

summary.name: PIXRAY
summary.one_liner: PIXRAY is a copyright enforcement platform for photographers and agencies that finds image infringements and settles them by offering the infringer a retroactive license ("Fair Licensing").
use_cases: Finding unlicensed uses of your photos online
Turning copyright infringers into paying customers via retroactive licenses
Replacing an existing copyright tracking provider
Connecting existing legal or collection partners to a detection platform
Building a recurring revenue stream from image copyright enforcement
summary.what_it_does: The page describes PIXRAY as a platform that detects copyright violations of images and lets agencies resolve them by selling a retroactive license, which it calls Fair Licensing. Customers can either work with PIXRAY's existing legal or money collection partners or connect their own partners to the platform. The company says it delivers a constant flow of findings over long periods so clients can plan predictable revenue. It also offers advisory services to help design and optimize copyright enforcement businesses. Communication under Fair Licensing is stated to happen directly between the infringer and the customer's sales team, with no middlemen.
notable: Fair Licensing: resolves infringements by offering a retroactive license instead of litigation
Success fee starts at 25% of payments received via Fair Licensing, or 33% via a collection partner
Customer case ownership and control; can use own legal or collection partners
Testimonial from dpa Picture-Alliance claiming ten times more violations detected than prior provider
caveats: Charges a success share on settled cases plus a monthly base fee that depends on coverage areas and number of pictures searched
Page does not state specific monthly fee amounts
Aimed at agencies and photographers; the page gives no general-purpose or individual-user use
Results claims (such as tenfold detection) are customer testimonials and vendor claims, not independently verified
